about: The jumpthrow.pro lineup video as data. Phase names match statechart/JumpthrowVideo.tla. Times are seconds into the MP4 of the reference video, observed in the built-in browser on 2026-11-02 at 0.1 s around each cut. scripts/template.py reads this file.

phases.name: leftover
phases.shows: the last frame of the previous spot

phases.name: spot
phases.shows: first person at the setpos, view level, arms drawing the grenade

phases.name: black
phases.shows: one mostly black frame as the zoomed view loads

phases.name: aimpoint
phases.shows: narrow FOV on the aim point, no arms, crosshair on it

phases.name: lineup
phases.shows: the setang at normal FOV with the grenade in hand

phases.name: throw
phases.shows: the game's throw animation; the jump lifts the view

phases.name: chase
phases.shows: a camera locked just behind the grenade along its flight, real time

phases.name: aftermath
phases.shows: the effect going off, the camera still locked to the grenade, clipping into walls and floor
phases.enter: the grenade goes off: release + airtime

events.name: loop
events.rule: the MP4 loops back to leftover

others.title: Ancient Smoke by MIBR saffee
others.matches: the same phases; zoomed hold seen at 3.75 s, chase from about 9.75 s, the same clipping at rest

others.title: Mirage Flash by The MongolZ cobrazera
others.matches: zoomed hold about 3.6-6.0 s, cut back about 6.6 s, throw about 9.6-9.9 s, grenade camera from about 9.95 s with the grenade in view and heading snaps at bounces; at rest and frozen from about 19.8 s
